Trilha do Atlântico Norte

A published daily route system over the North Atlantic, providing organized and coordinated tracks for transatlantic flights to maximize safety and efficiency.

Questions and answers

What is Trilha do Atlântico Norte?

In this glossary, Trilha do Atlântico Norte refers to: A published daily route system over the North Atlantic, providing organized and coordinated tracks for transatlantic flights to maximize safety and efficiency.

How is Trilha do Atlântico Norte used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Autorizado via trilha do Atlântico Norte Charlie, reporte os pontos de entrada e saída, mantenha o Mach designado."

Trilha do Atlântico Norte matters because it supports clear communication in Navigation contexts for Pilots, Air Traffic Controllers, and Cabin Crew. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as ICAO Level 4, ICAO Level 5, ICAO Level 6, and EASA FCL.055.

Definition

A published daily route system over the North Atlantic, providing organized and coordinated tracks for transatlantic flights to maximize safety and efficiency.

Operational example

Cleared via North Atlantic Track Charlie, report entry and exit points, maintain assigned Mach number.

Localized term

Trilha do Atlântico Norte

Localized example

Autorizado via trilha do Atlântico Norte Charlie, reporte os pontos de entrada e saída, mantenha o Mach designado.
